mapper.select: SELECT p.id, c.underpass_id, p.camera_id FROM plate_log p JOIN underpass_camera c ON c.id = p.camera_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE plate_log SET corrected_num = #{correctedNum}, car_id = #{carId}, review_status = 'CONFIRMED', review_deadline = NULL, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plate_log SET review_status = 'AUTO_PROCESSED', reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE review_status = 'PENDING' AND review_deadline < NOW()
